name: Turtle Forger
description: Recover a transient geometric master and compose a turtle punch-card program that reproduces its coloured seal.
natural_language: Inspect the UV reference until you can reconstruct every transient stroke. Build a compact two-ink punch-card program, proof it, then certify the plate.

metadata.source_notes: Original transient turtle-programming workbench grounded in Blockly Turtle's picture-to-program loop and CSSBattle's rendered similarity feedback; no source target or presentation asset is copied.
metadata.notes: The target is exposed only as a replayable one-stroke-at-a-time UV scan. The server and exported verifier replay every punch-card edit, execute the final structured program, and compare independently rasterized coloured geometry.
